Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Replace the shape list with a rule on what the callee hands back: price a callee by whether the reads escape through its return value, not by the form of its body. The design is yours to choose.

The finder's P2 applied with patch must still move only class_excess_loc / max_class_loc by +1. Re-record seam_cut_total only downward and state the figure from tests/structure.py at your head.
